records.name: Cynthia Warrick
records.priorTitle: Chief Academic and Administrative Officer role assumed on interim basis (specific prior title not disclosed in available sources)
records.notes: Named interim dean in 2026 following an expedited internal search after Chris Culbertson's departure; a national search for a permanent dean is expected to follow. Exact appointment date and full prior title not confirmed in available public sources.

records.name: Chris Culbertson
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean (2022-2023); Professor of Chemistry and Associate Dean of Research and Graduate Studies, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean starting June 20, 2022, then named permanent dean effective May 14, 2023 following a national search. Departed K-State in 2026 after being named dean of the McCausland College of Arts and Sciences at the University of South Carolina.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences

records.name: Jennifer A. Roberts
records.priorTitle: Senior Vice Provost for Academic Affairs (also previously Geology Department Chair and Vice Provost for Graduate Studies)
records.notes: Holds the title 'David B. Pittaway Executive Dean.' Promoted from within KU effective March 2, 2026, the same day Arash Mafi (her predecessor as dean) became KU provost.

records.name: Arash Mafi
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean and Director, Center for High Technology Materials; Professor of Physics and Electrical Engineering
records.notes: Joined KU in 2023 as executive dean of the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences; left the deanship in 2026 to become KU provost, replacing Barbara Bichelmeyer.

records.name: Carl W. Lejuez
records.priorTitle: Professor of Psychology and Associate Dean of Research, College of Behavioral and Social Sciences
records.notes: Named dean in September 2015 announcement, took office February 2016, succeeding interim dean Don Steeples.

records.name: Don Steeples
records.priorTitle: Dean A. McGee Distinguished Professor of Applied Geophysics; Deputy Director, Kansas Geological Survey
records.notes: Named interim dean in March 2015 after Danny Anderson departed to become president of Trinity University.

records.name: Danny Anderson
records.priorTitle: Unknown (prior appointment predates available sources)
records.notes: Left KU in spring 2015 to become president of Trinity University in San Antonio.

seats.school: Helen Way Klingler College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Heather Hathaway
records.priorTitle: Professor of English; previously Acting Dean (2019-2020) and Associate Dean for Academic Affairs (2005-08, 2017-19)
records.notes: Named acting dean of both the College of Arts & Sciences and College of Education effective August 1, 2025, while Dean Heidi Bostic took a sabbatical.

records.name: Heidi Bostic
records.priorTitle: Visiting Associate Provost for Special Projects
records.notes: Named dean February 20, 2020; began the role May 28, 2020. Led the college for five years before taking a sabbatical in 2025; Heather Hathaway had also served as acting dean immediately before Bostic's arrival (2019-2020).

records.name: Stephanie Shonekan
records.priorTitle: Senior Associate Dean, College of Arts and Science
records.notes: First woman dean of Arts & Humanities at Maryland; assumed the role in 2022 succeeding Bonnie Thornton Dill.

records.name: Bonnie Thornton Dill
records.priorTitle: Professor of Women's Studies and Sociology
records.notes: Served as dean for 11 years (2011-2022); succeeded James Harris, who had stepped down after 14 years as dean.

records.name: James Harris
records.priorTitle: Unknown (predates available sources)
records.notes: Referenced as Bonnie Thornton Dill's predecessor, having served approximately 14 years as dean before stepping down in 2011. Limited detail available in public sources.

records.name: Hashim Sarkis
records.priorTitle: Aga Khan Professor of Landscape Architecture and Urbanism
records.priorInstitution: Harvard University Graduate School of Design
records.notes: Appointed dean in January 2015, succeeding interim dean Mark Jarzombek.

records.name: Mark Jarzombek
records.priorTitle: Professor of the History and Theory of Architecture
records.notes: Named interim dean effective July 1, 2014, following Adele Naude Santos's departure from the deanship.

records.name: Adèle Naudé Santos
records.priorTitle: Unknown (prior title not specified in available sources)
records.notes: Served as dean of the School of Architecture and Planning from 2003 to 2014.

records.name: John de Monchaux
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Earlier dean included for historical context; there is a gap in documented deans between 1992 and 2003 (including William J. Mitchell's tenure) not fully resolved in available sources.

records.priorTitle: Provost Fellow for Faculty Recruitment and Hiring; Interim Director, Public Administration Program; Associate Dean for Faculty
records.notes: Named dean June 5, 2024, effective July 1, 2024, succeeding interim dean Joye Bowman.

records.name: Joye Bowman
records.priorTitle: Professor of History
records.notes: Served as interim dean for one year (2023-2024) after Barbara Krauthamer's departure, then returned to the History faculty.

records.name: Barbara Krauthamer
records.priorTitle: Dean of the Graduate School and Senior Vice Provost for Interdisciplinary Programs and Innovation; Professor of History
records.notes: Named dean March 26, 2020, promoted from within after leading the Graduate School since 2017.

records.name: Leonidas G. Bachas
records.priorTitle: Frank J. Derbyshire Professor of Chemistry and Chair, Department of Chemistry
records.notes: Joined University of Miami as dean in July 2010 and remains dean as of 2025-2026. No public source identifying his predecessor or any successor was found during this research.

records.name: Thomas Stubblefield
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences; Interim Director, Harrington School of Communication and Media; Professor of Art and Art History
records.notes: The 12th dean of the College of Arts & Letters; began July 1, 2025, following Board of Trustees approval June 13, 2025.

records.name: Yen-Hwei Lin
records.priorTitle: Professor (Linguistics)
records.notes: Named interim dean effective June 10, 2024, after Christopher Long departed to become provost at the University of Oregon.

records.name: Christopher P. Long
records.priorTitle: Unknown prior to 2015 (predates available sources in detail)
records.notes: Served as dean from July 2015 to June 2024 (~9 years); left to become provost and senior vice president at the University of Oregon.

records.name: Elizabeth H. Simmons
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Served as acting dean 2014-2015 between Karin Wurst's tenure (2006-2014) and Christopher Long's appointment (2015).

records.name: Lee M. Cohen
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, Department of Psychological Sciences
records.notes: Assumed the deanship August 1, 2015, and continues to serve as of 2026 (confirmed current via the college's website). Predecessor not identified in available sources.

records.name: Cooper Drury
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean (2021-2022); Senior Associate Dean; Professor
records.notes: Served as interim dean from June 2021 and was named permanent dean effective May 13, 2022, succeeding Patricia Okker.

records.name: Patricia Okker
records.priorTitle: Professor of English; Department Chair (2005-2011)
records.notes: Served as dean from 2017 to 2021; departed to become president of New College of Florida in July 2021.

records.name: Christina Yoshimura
records.priorTitle: Professor of Communication Studies
records.notes: In August 2025, the College of Humanities and Sciences was split into a new College of Science (interim dean Bruce Bowler) and a college of humanities and social sciences (interim dean Yoshimura, official name pending Board of Regents approval). National searches for permanent deans of both new colleges were planned for 2025-26.

records.name: Larry Hufford
records.priorTitle: Herbert L. Eastlick Distinguished Professor; Director, Marion Ownbey Herbarium and Conner Museum of Natural History
records.notes: Started as dean July 1, 2020, succeeding interim dean Jenny McNulty; led the college until its 2025 restructuring.

records.name: Jenny McNulty
records.priorTitle: Professor of Mathematics

records.name: Christopher Comer
records.priorTitle: Unknown (predates available sources)

records.name: Patrick Dussault
records.priorTitle: Unknown (specific prior title not confirmed in available sources)

records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Computer Science and Engineering

records.name: David Manderscheid

records.name: Chris Heavey
records.priorTitle: Unknown (predates available sources)
